question: Who among the following became the first-ever Indian cricket player to play 400 T20s?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rohit Sharma became the first-ever Indian cricket player to** play 400 T20s**.
 
• He achieved the feat on March 8, 2023, during the third T20I match against Sri Lanka in Lucknow</str
